steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: What are we waiting for?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: A phone call. Might be a novel thing for someone as old as you.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: How much longer must we wait here?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: No more questions, just wait and see.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Can I take the call? Someone explained how it works to me a while back...

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Nuh-uh-uh. No can do. They'll think we're a scam call the moment they hear your robotic voice.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Right. As you mentioned earlier, us working together is an imitation of the greatest alliance in history.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Sooo... can I ask what's in store for me, if I help you find your gem?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Oh wait, I did get something already. I got a golden slipper thrown in my face after you scared me last night.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Do you have any suggestions?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: ——No, no, I wouldn't dare ask for more. Letting me live is already more than enough. You're one of Sargon's forefathers, I should be escorting you on your quest. So please, don't be hasty.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Though, the artifact that won first place at the Harvest Gathering seemed to resemble this very gold slipper, inlaid with sapphires...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Yes, the two of them complete the pair.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Is making a ruckus in the dead of night also a way to make a fortune?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: They originally came in a pair, but one was lost forever in the depths of the river, so this other one naturally has its value halved.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Please entertain my curiosity. Are all modern Nightzmora... like you?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Beats me.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I've looked into the customs and beliefs of many tribes for my plunders, fences, and abductions, but I never looked into my own birthplace.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I never went back after that one sunrise.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: I don't suppose... you are presently on your Khaganquest?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Khaganquest?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: (Ancient language) Khaganquest.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: ——Nuh-uh, that's the last word I ever want to hear.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I'm not doing it, not even if my ancestors compel me to.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: You mean you never performed your coming-of-age ritual?!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Yeah? It's not that important.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I might have a few drops of Nightzmoran blood in me, but they didn't turn me into a tyrant or a conqueror, and I have no intention of letting them influence my life either.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: No, it is very important.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: How will your forebears recognize your blood, if you don't embark on your Khaganquest?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: It's fine, most of them pretty much disappeared off the ends of the earth. Unlike someone I know who suddenly sprang to life at the museum just to lecture me.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: So yeah, what about you?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I've heard that in the Shah's time, people would shave their heads bald when they came of age, that they applied perfumed ointment to their scalps. But some say the scent smelled more like a stench... so I'm pretty curious if that's true.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: I also...

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Oh, there we go.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Huh, I didn't expect to get news so soon.

steps.name: Gemstone Broker
steps.text: Yes, hanim. It just so happens the gem trading post's overseer sent word that he has a gem to trade, and it fits your description in all aspects.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Good, I'll go to him right away.

steps.name: Gemstone Broker
steps.text: But... it will be difficult negotiating a deal, even with my introduction.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: What? I heard from my subordinates they could simply sell their gems at the reception.

steps.name: Gemstone Broker
steps.text: Selling is easy, but not the other way round. The trading post does not operate like a regular store. You need to offer something heavy enough to balance the scales.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Something heavy? In value?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: ...I have an idea.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Ahem, yes. This is the deal I wanted to discuss.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: The ancient mummy from the recent museum exhibition... The Nameless General of the Shah's Very Court.
The young overseer shoots her a complicated look, and leans down to the huge gilded box.
Zubayr lies inside silently, with his hands folded across his chest.
Narantuya thinks this is honestly Zubayr's time to shine—even his dreadful golden mask seems to be emitting a soft, sacred glow.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: This box looks familiar.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: It is a sarcophagus taken from the museum in its original condition... a replica of it, I mean.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: ...(Lightly taps Zubayr's body)

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: (Examines his chest with a flashlight)

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Um, this isn't a regular artifact you can find anywhere. So if you could be more gentle and professional with it...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: ...I hear it came back to life, and can move on its own.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: About that... I'm sure we all know the dead don't come back to life. Just Arts at play is all.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I mean, wouldn't you be afraid, if it really could move?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Afraid it might run off after, I buy it?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Well, uh...

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Oh, is that black one your pet? Haha, what a beauty!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Of course the gem trading post's overseer, who controls the flow of money throughout the entire city, would have such a unique pet.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: (Whisper) Is that him, Woof?

steps.name: Woof
steps.text: (Sniffs)

steps.name: Woof
steps.text: (Sits besides the sarcophagus)

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Hey, look. It sniffed out the millennia-old stench you can never fake.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: It's as real as my sincerity in making this deal with you.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Of course, I know how precious this artifact is, and it'll be quite troublesome for you to handle it—I'm basically offloading my troubles to you, so I'm not exactly hoping for a windfall.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: But I guarantee the museum has no way of tracking me down...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: No, this is an extremely heavy offer you've made.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Though it's still within the measuring limits of my scale.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Uh, okay.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: What do you want in exchange? I hear you came for a gemstone.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Well, that was the original plan, but I thought of something else on the way over. I don't need that gem anymore.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I'm an outsider, so ingots will do.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: You wish to be paid in Pure Gold? I'll go fetch the appropriate scales.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Please bring this inside to keep others from seeing it.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: So... we got a deal?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Ha, I love a man who does easy business!

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: I don't like the feeling of sleeping in here one bit. You didn't have to get your subordinates to bring it here in the first place.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Ssh, don't speak... Just hold on a bit longer, I'll come retrieve you soon.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Seize the chance and find the gem you're after before the day ends.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Alright, please do come back. I still need you for something.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: This is the price I'm offering. Any objection?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Phew... ♪Remember the crescent moon on the blade, the youth's sincerity washed into gold♪

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I'll be back for sure... no objections at all! Nope!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Well, I'll be going now.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: By all means.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: (Blinks at Zubayr)

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: (Blinks at Narantuya)

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I look forward to any future cooperation!

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: I never said we'd have any future cooperation.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Hah, me neither—in the near future, at least.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: That old thing wants me to run errands for him? Sorry, but see ya!

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: ...She should have understood my signal? Narantuya, if you're truly a descendant of the Nightzmora...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: A treasury awaits you.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: He finally followed the notices I sent around and came here...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Mio, Woof.

steps.name: Woof
steps.text: Well done, Lazvar.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: You have earned our praise.
